<h3>A lot of fun <strong>activities</strong></h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">The campsite has a pool with Surfing Hill, a multi arena for<br />
ball games and a child-friendly playroom. You can go fishing, swimming<br />
and windsurfing. You can also find a creative workshop and miniature<br />
golfing for the whole family.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div fa-arrow-circle-right" style="color:#1970b8 !important"></span><a class="vc_icon_element-link" href="https://www.drejby.com/activities-at-the-campsite/"  title="Activities at the campsite" target="_self"></a></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1613821695855"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 450px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div><div data-min-height="450" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid switch-order-mobile full-width-wrap dt-default" style="padding-left: 0px;padding-right: 0px;margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1613032783997"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="ultimate-heading-16686acd5660d4377" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-16686acd5660d4377 uvc-7160  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-sub-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-16686acd5660d4377 .uvc-sub-heading '  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-weight:normal;"></p>
<h3>South Jutland is full of <strong>experiences</strong></h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center;">Outside the campsite a lot of experiences are waiting,<br />
Kegnæs Fyr, Segway in the nature, the beautiful<br />
Gendarmsti, Universe, Sønderborg and Als.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div class="vc_icon_element-inner vc_icon_element-color-custom vc_icon_element-size-lg vc_icon_element-style- vc_icon_element-background-color-grey" ><span class="vc_icon_element-icon fas fa-arrow-circle-right" style="color:#007cba !important"></span><a class="vc_icon_element-link" href="https://www.drejby.com/activities-in-the-area/"  title="Aktiviteter i området" target="_self"></a></div></div></div></div></div></div><div data-min-height="450px" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid switch-order-mobile, columns-2 full-width-wrap dt-default" style="padding-left: 0px;padding-right: 0px;margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1613032761168"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="ultimate-heading-22466acd5660d461d" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-22466acd5660d461d uvc-5869  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-sub-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-22466acd5660d461d .uvc-sub-heading '  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-weight:normal;"></p>
<h3>Kegnæs – a small unique island, worth a visit</h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p style="text-align: center; max-width: 620px;">Kegnæs is an island connected to the mainland, located just across the strait, connected by the isthmus &#8220;Drejet&#8221;, south of Drejby Camping. Kegnæs is 8 km long and up to 3 km wide. On Kegnæs, you can stroll among vineyards, hike along the Kegnæs Path, cycle around the island, visit art galleries, feel the breath of history in Kegnæs Church, and see it all from above from Kegnæs Lighthouse.</p>

		</div>
	</div>
<div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 32px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div><div class="vc_icon_element vc_icon_element-outer vc_do_icon vc_icon_element-align-center"><div class="vc_icon_element-inner vc_icon_element-color-custom vc_icon_element-size-lg vc_icon_element-style- vc_icon_element-background-color-grey" ><span class="vc_icon_element-icon fas fa-arrow-circle-right" style="color:#1970b8 !important"></span><a class="vc_icon_element-link" href="https://www.drejby.com/kegnaes-island/"  title="Kegnæs – a small island, worth a visit" target="_self"></a></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-6 vc_col-has-fill"><div class="vc_column-inner vc_custom_1719234998577"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div class="vc_empty_space"   style="height: 450px"><span class="vc_empty_space_inner"></span></div></div></div></div></div><div id="travellers-choice" data-anchor="#travellers-choice" class="vc_row wpb_row vc_row-fluid py-5 full-width-wrap dt-default" style="padding-left: 0px;padding-right: 0px;margin-top: 0px;margin-bottom: 0px"><div class="wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-2"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"></div></div></div><div class="text-center col-max-content-760px wpb_column vc_column_container vc_col-sm-8"><div class="vc_column-inner"><div class="wpb_wrapper"><div id="ultimate-heading-71736acd5660d4cf8" class="uvc-heading ult-adjust-bottom-margin ultimate-heading-71736acd5660d4cf8 uvc-8185  uvc-heading-default-font-sizes" data-hspacer="no_spacer"  data-halign="center" style="text-align:center"><div class="uvc-heading-spacer no_spacer" style="top"></div><div class="uvc-sub-heading ult-responsive"  data-ultimate-target='.uvc-heading.ultimate-heading-71736acd5660d4cf8 .uvc-sub-heading '  data-responsive-json-new='{"font-size":"","line-height":""}'  style="font-weight:normal;"></p>
<h3>Drejby Strandcamping has received the<br />
<strong>Travelers’ Choice Award</strong></h3>
<p></div></div>
	<div class="wpb_text_column wpb_content_element " >
		<div class="wpb_wrapper">
			<p>We are proud and delighted to announce that this year we have received the Tripadvisor Travelers’ Choice Award. The award is given based on guest reviews, and therefore it means something very special to us. After all, it is you, our guests, who have helped make this possible.</p>
<p>Thank you so much to all of you who have visited us, reviewed us, and shared your experiences. We are both grateful and proud, and we look forward to welcoming even more guests here with us.</p>

		</div>
